description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Hiththatiya, Matara D/S Division, Matara District (25/0178)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including owner names, parcel numbers, extents, and legal status. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
